title: A Counterexample to Yau's Conjectured Asymptotic Scalar-Curvature Integral Bound
summary: A complete one-ended three-manifold with strictly positive Ricci curvature is constructed such that $$ \limsup_{R\to\infty}\frac1R\int_{B(p,R)} Scal\,dV=+\infty. $$ The construction combines an explicit toric lens carrying a large scalar-curvature integral with a three-dimensional angular pair of pants and an adaptive sequence of hybrid blocks.
